verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for an API-driven financial platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of restricted, scoped or least-privilege API keys for agents. The third-party debit authorization, MCP server and CLI items are adjacent features, not scoped credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
